subject: Redwood procurement and pricing — next steps & packaging options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acmefinancial.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood procurement and pricing — next steps & packaging options

Hi Samir / Procurement team,

Great to meet this morning — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of needs (from our call):
- Production inference for a customer-facing feature (low-latency critical).
- Must meet Acme Financial procurement rules: PO-first preferred, longer payment terms (Net 45), vendor onboarding required.
- Security requirements: SOC 2 Type II, KMS integration, audit logs retention policy.
- Expected steady state throughput ~50 req/s with spikes to 150 req/s during batch windows.

Commercial / packaging options to consider (high level):
1) Hosted API (Redwood Hosted)
   - On-demand pricing (per token & embedding) — fast to start, minimal paper.
   - Good for pilots; no upfront commit required.
2) Dedicated (Reserved capacity)
   - Monthly/annual reserved GPU pools with commit-based discounts.
   - Suitable for predictable throughput and tighter latency SLOs.
   - Supports SLA and isolated capacity for regulated workloads.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem)
   - Enterprise licensing + deployment options for air-gapped/regulated use.
   - Typically requires licensing negotiation and longer procurement.

Given your procurement preference (PO + marketplace interest), two recommended paths: 
A) Dedicated commit (12-month) procured via PO — best balance of unit cost vs procurement cadence.
B) Hosted on-demand to start (card or standard vendor onboarding) while procurement processes Dedicated via PO in parallel.

Attachments: proposal and draft SOW attached for your procurement team to review.

Next steps / asks: 
- Can procurement confirm if AWS Marketplace would be preferred for faster approval and consolidated billing?
- Can you share the procurement contact (name/email) to route the SOW and vendor form?
- Dev: can we schedule a 30-min tech touch with your infra team next week to confirm KMS + network requirements?

I can prepare two commercial paths (Hosted on-demand quote + Dedicated 12-month commit quote) and a short comparison sheet for procurement. Looking to get this into a PO-ready state.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Redwood procurement and pricing — next steps & packaging options

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement side: 

- Procurement: we generally process via PO; card payments are only for low-dollar pilots and require a separate approval. So PO-first is preferred.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is preferred if available because it simplifies billing & approval, but not required — procurement will accept a PO if vendor paperwork is complete.
- Discounting: what kind of discount tiers are available for a 12-month commit vs month-to-month? Need high-level (% off list, or $/token guidance) to brief finance.
- Timeline: we have a vendor intake meeting next Thursday 3/11 where we'd like Redwood sales/legal to be able to answer vendor form questions.

Also looping in Procurement (procurement@acmefinancial.com) to capture the internal onboarding steps.

Can you confirm whether the Dedicated offering supports the SSO/KMS integrations we asked about and if SOC 2 docs can be shared for vendor vetting?

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Head of Product, Acme Financial
samir.shah@acmefinancial.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acmefinancial.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood procurement and pricing — next steps & packaging options

Thanks Samir — great questions. Quick answers and what we'll deliver to make the vendor intake meeting on 3/11 effective.

1) Discounts / pricing guidance (high-level)
   - Hosted (on-demand): standard list, no commit. We can provide a pilot credit to shorten trial period.
   - Dedicated (12-month commit): typically 20-35% off list depending on commit size. Example: for your expected sustained throughput (50 req/s), we can show modeled $/1k tokens at X% below hosted. I'll include exact tiers in the formal quote.
   - Private (on-prem): negotiated enterprise pricing + seat/license options.

2) PO & Marketplace
   - We support PO with standard vendor onboarding. We also have an AWS Marketplace listing in progress (expected Q2) — if that timing works, it will simplify things; otherwise we can proceed by PO.

3) Security / integrations
   - SOC 2 Type II report (summary + non-confidential attestation) — attached to this thread (redacted).
   - Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) for encryption at rest and integrates with SSO via SAML/SCIM for user provisioning on the control plane. We'll have Dev run a short tech session to validate network egress and KMS endpoints.

4) Deliverables by EOD tomorrow:
   - Two formal quotes: (a) Hosted on-demand pilot quote, (b) Dedicated 12-month commit quote with tiered discounts.
   - Short comparison sheet (hosted vs dedicated vs private) tailored to Acme's requirements.
   - Vendor form + SOW pre-filled for procurement to review.

Aditya / Dev — can you confirm availability for a 30-min tech call on 3/9 or 3/10? We should include a short network/KMS checklist in the SOW.

Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference

Marissa — this is helpful. Procurement confirms we prefer PO route. A few quick items: 

- We'll plan to push Redwood on the vendor intake meeting (3/11). Can someone from legal/sales be available?
- If you can show committed pricing for a 12-month Dedicated path (approx % tiers you mentioned) we'll likely proceed with PO for Dedicated. Finance needs a clear committed price to approve.
- Procurement contact: Jenna Park (jenna.park@acmefinancial.com). Please send the SOW and vendor form directly to her.

I'll schedule the vendor intake invite and include the procurement packet. Thanks for turning the quotes around quickly.

Best,
Samir
